digest.component_or_area: Git outcome classification and retry policy in store operations
propositions: Five separate sites classify the same git failure strings with inconsistent verdicts, requiring a single consolidated classifier function and outcome registry keyed by operation
The synthetic rc-124 timeout result is constructed at four different places with only one having transient retry support, leaving sync._union_merge and push_recovery without retry coverage

The string 'cannot lock ref' must preserve three deliberately different verdicts across operations (local retriable lock, lease-push non-mismatch reject, ref-cas advisory-lock-held terminal) without merging to avoid re-opening bugs 4afc and ebee
A tenth outcome kind INVALID_OBJECT must be distinguished from FATAL because its recovery is index rebuild-then-retry, not terminal failure

Guard A must statically prove the four marker strings appear only as non-docstring ast.Constant literals in git_outcome.py, and Guard B must prove the synthetic-timeout construction occurs exactly once in src/rebar/_store/gitutil.py

The classifier signature classify(result, *, operation) must accept CompletedProcess, CalledProcessError, or bare string, run structural predicates first per operation, then fall through to marker-based registry rows
